input.quote: Throughout the Term of this Agreement, M&I shall maintain at all times at its own cost and expense:
input.rationale: Section 14.1 requires M&I to carry commercial general liability ($2,000,000 primary limits), fidelity ($10,000,000), workers' compensation with $500,000 employer's liability, and all-risk property cover, with certificates of insurance delivered at Customer's request (p0217). CGL, workers' compensation and certificates therefore meet the preferred position. However, M&I is a data processing/hosting vendor handling Customer data, and the clause contains no professional liability (E&O) and no cyber/privacy liability coverage; fidelity insurance covers employee dishonesty only and is not a substitute for either. The clause consequently fails the fallback (E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M) on a material term, so we inserted E&O at $2,000,000 and cyber/privacy at $5,000,000 as new items 5 and 6, with the fallback limits offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Add professional liability (E&O) and cyber liability coverage to M&I's insurance obligations
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The insurance clause omits professional liability and cyber coverage, so we added E&O of $2,000,000 and cyber/privacy liability of $5,000,000 given M&I processes our customer data. We can accept $1,000,000 E&O and $2,000,000 cyber as a fallback.

ops.text: Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions) Insurance covering the Services, in an amount not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000).
Cyber and Privacy Liability Insurance covering unauthorized access to, or loss or disclosure of, Customer data, in an amount not less than five million dollars ($5,000,000).
